_comment: This is an EXAMPLE. The real file is oxide/config/XiveWhitelist.json, which the plugin
writes itself the first time it loads. Copy values across; do not replace the generated
file with this one, or the _comment key will be written back on every save.
DO NOT COMMIT THE REAL FILE TO A PUBLIC REPOSITORY. That is the most common way a server
key leaks. If it happens, revoke it in your hub: Settings -> Integrations -> Rust.
